components.name: Primary Action
components.description: Use for the main next step on a light surface.
components.css: .ds-button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 50px; padding: 0 24px; border: 1px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 0; background: var(--ink); color: var(--linen); font: 500 15px/1.2 var(--sans); text-decoration: none; transition: background .2s, color .2s; } .ds-button:hover { border-color: var(--blue-text); background: var(--blue-text); color: var(--white); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue-text); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Hero Inverse Action
components.description: Use over the darkened homepage photograph.
components.css: .ds-hero-button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 50px; padding: 0 24px; border: 1px solid var(--white); border-radius: 0; background: var(--white); color: var(--ink); font: 500 15px/1.2 var(--sans); text-decoration: none; transition: background .2s, color .2s; } .ds-hero-button:hover { background: #E7EDF0; } .ds-hero-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--white); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: Use in the shared desktop navigation; indicate the current route with an underline.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { display: inline-block; padding: 8px 0; color: var(--ink); font: 500 15px/1.4 var(--sans); text-decoration: none; text-underline-offset: 8px; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link[aria-current=page] { text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: var(--ink); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue-text); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Use for enquiry form entry on white surfaces.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 7px; color: var(--ink); font: 600 14px/1.4 var(--sans); } .ds-field input { width: 100%; min-height: 50px; padding: 13px 14px; border: 1px solid #8E9BA4; border-radius: 0; background: var(--white); color: var(--ink); font: 400 16px/1.4 var(--sans); box-shadow: none; } .ds-field input:focus { outline: 2px solid var(--blue-text); outline-offset: 2px; border-color: var(--blue-text); }

components.name: Choice Chip
components.description: Use for compact selectable enquiry options.
components.css: .ds-choice { display: inline-block; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: 0; background: var(--white); color: var(--ink); font: 400 14px/1.4 var(--sans); cursor: pointer; } .ds-choice:hover, .ds-choice[aria-pressed=true] { border-color: var(--ink); background: var(--ink); color: var(--white); } .ds-choice:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue-text); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Tasting-Sheet Row
components.description: Use to present a concise origin, quality, or format fact without a card.
components.css: .ds-sheet-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 200px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 24px; padding: 18px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); color: var(--ink); } .ds-sheet-row dt { padding-top: 4px; color: var(--ink-soft); font: 600 13px/1.4 var(--sans); letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-sheet-row dd { margin: 0; color: var(--ink); font: 400 22px/1.35 var(--serif); } @media (max-width: 720px) { .ds-sheet-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 4px; } .ds-sheet-row dd { font-size: 20px; } }

narrative.overview:
The site carries the welcome of a Hawke’s Bay cellar door into an everyday water brand. Its visual language pairs cool linen-like white with deep navy, the HBay blue mark, restrained rules, and the warmth of place-led photography. Bodoni Moda gives headlines the character of an estate label; Hanken Grotesk keeps navigation, facts, and forms direct and readable.

The homepage invites shoppers to a set table among the vines, then moves through source and tasting notes, everyday settings, the range, and places to buy. The other seven routes use the same masthead, footer, type, and palette, with their own editorial pace. Lifestyle images are labelled as AI concepts, and the homepage hero flags the package appearance as awaiting confirmation.
keyCharacteristics: Region-led hospitality, expressed through a water brand.
Printed tasting-sheet cues: hairline rules, aligned values, and open space.
Clear contrast between the navy-and-linen foundation and small blue actions.
One responsive navigation and footer system across eight pages.

rules.name: The Ink-and-Linen Rule
rules.body: Keep the page calm and legible with navy type over linen or white. Reserve the brighter brand blue for brand recognition; use the deeper blue for text interactions.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Use Bodoni Moda for expressive headings and selected values; use Hanken Grotesk for every interface label, paragraph, navigation item, and control.

rules.name: The Tasting-Sheet Rule
rules.body: For origin, quality, format, and other concise facts, align labels and values against a rule instead of placing each fact in a separate card.

dos: Do keep the exact brand slogan, “More Natural Better Living,” wherever the current site displays it.
Do preserve the source and imagery caveats: generated lifestyle scenes are concepts, and the homepage pack appearance needs client confirmation.
Do use darker blue for text links and keyboard focus, while keeping the brighter blue tied to the logo and brand mark.
Do keep editorial facts in ruled rows and preserve the generous, responsive page gutters.
donts: Don't put text into photographs; keep words as live page content.
Don't default to blue splash or snowy-mountain category imagery; the chosen visual story belongs to Hawke’s Bay and its long-lunch setting.
Don't turn every content group into a rounded card or add decorative kicker labels and numbered sequence markers.
Don't present the single-sample mineral results as fixed specifications or the concept bottle as confirmed package photography.
